acts.name: The Belly of the Beast Level 1
The Belly of the Beast Level 2

Imperial Legacy.name: Imperial Legacy
Imperial Legacy.flavourText: A life lost, A legacy born.

The Spark and the Flame.name: The Spark and the Flame
The Spark and the Flame.flavourText: When sky meets ground the flames can be found, but who has the will to tame them.

The Oath.name: The Oath
The Oath.flavourText: An oath once made is an oath never broken. Do not delay in keeping it, for I take no pleasure in fools.

Bowyer's Dream.name: Bowyer's Dream
Bowyer's Dream.flavourText: If this is my dream, I don't wish to wake.

Home.name: Home
Home.flavourText:
There are countless people,
countless stories,
and countless eras,
but there is one place that,
for a time, each of us loved
and was loved. It matters.
We matter.

Lost Worlds.name: Lost Worlds
Lost Worlds.flavourText:
"There are worlds that lie beyond the edge of my page, the edge of my understanding. Worlds of wonder. Worlds of terror."
Aramil - Cartographer to Emperor Chitus

The Destination.name: The Destination
The Destination.flavourText: You may be nothing to everybody, but you are everything to somebody.

Azure Rage.name: Azure Rage
Azure Rage.flavourText:
The mask hides his identity
but also makes it hard to read...

Dementophobia.name: Dementophobia
Dementophobia.flavourText:
I never truly understood the depths of my insanity,
until I realized the voices beckoning me towards the abyss,
were none other than my own.

Brother's Gift.name: Brother's Gift
Brother's Gift.flavourText:
Even though his flame has burned out,
he will never fade away.

The Fortunate.name: The Fortunate
The Fortunate.flavourText:
The fortunate find 
generosity in the divine.

The Garish Power.name: The Garish Power
The Garish Power.flavourText: Maligaro may have valued function over form, but that did not mute his flair for the dramatic.

The Tinkerer's Table.name: The Tinkerer's Table
The Tinkerer's Table.flavourText: Trying to bring your vision to life is enough to drive you mad.

The Survivalist.name: The Survivalist
The Survivalist.flavourText:
A lucky number 
For us all 
To help us through 
The perils told.

The Tower.name: The Tower
The Tower.flavourText: A tower built of the strongest stone is not eternal; a towering intellect is not enlightened.

The Gentleman.name: The Gentleman
The Gentleman.flavourText: "Axes and mauls are so uncivilised. A good clean cut to the neck with a sharp blade, that's the Sarn way!"

The Chosen.name: The Chosen
The Chosen.flavourText: They whose lives were given to clothe the Dark Dreamer... They were the lucky ones.

The Bones.name: The Bones
The Bones.flavourText: The flesh is a prison, and we are finally free.

The One That Got Away.name: The One That Got Away
The One That Got Away.flavourText:
Savor life's missing pieces.
To complete one's final goal
is to take one's last breath.

Who Asked.name: Who Asked
Who Asked.flavourText:
In the midst 
of unrelenting requests,
the blacksmith's forge 
conjures the unpredictable
Countless voices, countless desires – 
yielding weapons as diverse
as those who ask

Birth of the Three.name: Birth of the Three
Birth of the Three.flavourText: A small token of Her affliction.

The Cacophony.name: The Cacophony
The Cacophony.flavourText: Nothing can be heard above the din or seen amongst the turmoil. The senses are shattered. All is left to fate.

The Dark Mage.name: The Dark Mage
The Dark Mage.flavourText:
With staff in hand
and wrath in heart,
your soul and corpse
shall surely part.

The Mind's Eyes.name: The Mind's Eyes
The Mind's Eyes.flavourText:
Through the eyes of a person, 
you can see their soul
Through the eyes of a jewel, 
you can see the universe

The White Knight.name: The White Knight
The White Knight.flavourText: Where Decay festers, I shall expunge it, and leave in its place a shining monument.

Deadly Joy.name: Deadly Joy
Deadly Joy.flavourText:
"Be fast. That is all that matters."
- Rita of the Asylum

Buried Treasure.name: Buried Treasure
Buried Treasure.flavourText: You can't seek riches without getting your hands dirty.

Might is Right.name: Might is Right
Might is Right.flavourText: The mind had much to endure before the advent of thaumaturgy.

The Traitor.name: The Traitor
The Traitor.flavourText:
Sometimes an apprentice becomes a master through countless hours of hard work and practice.
Sometimes it happens by force.

The Vast.name: The Vast
The Vast.flavourText:
Can you hear the siren's calls,
Just beyond the sea?
A voice which hearts
of men enthralls,
I too am hooked to thee.

The Tireless Extractor.name: The Tireless Extractor
The Tireless Extractor.flavourText:
"I am not alone in this. I have God by my side! And... you help sometimes, I suppose."
- Sister Cassia

Vinia's Token.name: Vinia's Token
Vinia's Token.flavourText: You can change your name, but you cannot change your history.

The Watcher.name: The Watcher
The Watcher.flavourText:
Strange eyes on top of spines 
Gaze beyond the veil of time 
Deep down below the mines 
A dream of crimson and of grime

The Sword King's Salute.name: The Sword King's Salute
The Sword King's Salute.flavourText:
Many were slain by the sword king 
Their blood decorating his ring 
Those who retreated were slaughtered 
Those who fought bravely were honoured

The Avenger.name: The Avenger
The Avenger.flavourText:
Justice comes swift 
Equal to the crime 
Revenge is a gift 
Life for a life 
Eye for an eye

A Stone Perfected.name: A Stone Perfected
A Stone Perfected.flavourText: They gave the stone life. Over eons spent bathed in Corruption, that life evolved.

Keeper's Corruption.name: Keeper's Corruption
Keeper's Corruption.flavourText:
With great power comes...

...Even greater power.

Treasure Hunter.name: Treasure Hunter
Treasure Hunter.flavourText:
"Don't worry, I know what I'm doing."
- Toggo's Last Words

The Army of Blood.name: The Army of Blood
The Army of Blood.flavourText:
I gave my mind without a fight, 
The twelfth hour I lost control. 
The day is gone but there is light, 
eyes that glow like red-hot coal.

Brotherhood in Exile.name: Brotherhood in Exile
Brotherhood in Exile.flavourText:
Seeking shelter from the night,
in the warmth of the run-down inn,
erstwhile foes put aside the fight,
to bond over whiskey and gin.

The Flora's Gift.name: The Flora's Gift
The Flora's Gift.flavourText:
Sturdy and strong,
grown from the stream.
The Flora that live here,
A combatant's dream.

Struck by Lightning.name: Struck by Lightning
Struck by Lightning.flavourText:
'Lightning never strikes the same place twice'
is really just wishful thinking.

Boon of the First Ones.name: Boon of the First Ones
Boon of the First Ones.flavourText:
Wreathed in the skin and bones
of the beasts she slew, 
her gift came from what she lost: 
her humanity.

The Encroaching Darkness.name: The Encroaching Darkness
The Encroaching Darkness.flavourText: No matter where your dreams take you, Nightmare follows close behind.

The Finishing Touch.name: The Finishing Touch
The Finishing Touch.flavourText: A little extra flair never hurts.

The Wrath.name: The Wrath
The Wrath.flavourText: "Daughter of catastrophe, mother of pain. Amongst the filth of Wraeclast, she wanders, and her wrath follows." - Quintoon the Returned

No Traces.name: No Traces
No Traces.flavourText: There is no mistake so great that it cannot be undone.

Emperor of Purity.name: Emperor of Purity
Emperor of Purity.flavourText:
True to his title,
Voll, newly crowned,
had many of the
Eternal Empire's signature
extravagances destroyed.

A Dusty Memory.name: A Dusty Memory
A Dusty Memory.flavourText: In the oldest halls of my mind, at the end of a rarely used passage, lies my greatest treasure: one moment of happiness and innocence, pure and untouchable.

Hope.name: Hope
Hope.flavourText: The others succumbed to madness and depravity, but Lori fought on. Alone in the darkness, she could still see the dull light of hope's distant dawn.

Peaceful Moments.name: Peaceful Moments
Peaceful Moments.flavourText: Savour these moments, for they may never return.

The Dragon.name: The Dragon
The Dragon.flavourText:
Scaly beast of the skies,
watching with his golden eyes.
Shadow that blocks out the sun,
it's too late for you to run.

The Scavenger.name: The Scavenger
The Scavenger.flavourText: Take small pieces of things and then assemble them together

Monochrome.name: Monochrome
Monochrome.flavourText:
"You cannot portray the world using just one colour. Together, you and I, we will paint our world into perfection." 
- Kyra, renegade thaumaturgist

Desecrated Virtue.name: Desecrated Virtue
Desecrated Virtue.flavourText:
Awoken virtuous slivers of the void,
defiled by the avaricious, 
seized by the tyrannical.

Prejudice.name: Prejudice
Prejudice.flavourText: One who is blinded by their past may only see a sliver of the present.

The Card Sharp.name: The Card Sharp
The Card Sharp.flavourText: "The house always wins... except when I do."

The Surveyor.name: The Surveyor
The Surveyor.flavourText: Exploring lands made of flesh and sorrow, we'll reap and plunder like there's no tomorrow.

The Hunger.name: The Hunger
The Hunger.flavourText:
"How many lives have you consumed?" 
"How many times have you blinked?"

Hubris.name: Hubris
Hubris.flavourText:
"This one? It is NOT for sale. You would sooner pry it from my lifeless hand."
- Jonfé Darontos, Ringmaker

The Silly Boy.name: The Silly Boy
The Silly Boy.flavourText:
From silly pondering
comes legend,
and from legend,
horned fortune

The Lord of Celebration.name: The Lord of Celebration
The Lord of Celebration.flavourText: Though they were a pack of elite combatants, the Emperor's royal guards were not ready to face one of his notorious parties.

The Carrion Crow.name: The Carrion Crow
The Carrion Crow.flavourText:
From death, life. 
From life, death. 
The wheel turns, 
and the corbies wheel overhead.

Blind Venture.name: Blind Venture
Blind Venture.flavourText:
"It's risky not knowing where your wares come from. That's why I source my own."
- Klayver, the Antiquarian

Mitts.name: Mitts
Mitts.flavourText: Those whose hands are their livelihood know the importance of keeping them safe and warm.

The Dreamer.name: The Dreamer
The Dreamer.flavourText:
A dark note drips 
from the dreamer's lips, 
A honeyed melody. 
We stand, we fall 
on his beck and call, 
for in his dream we're free.

The Adventuring Spirit.name: The Adventuring Spirit
The Adventuring Spirit.flavourText: Dost thou lead my men to victory, my child?

The Master.name: The Master
The Master.flavourText: In a world filled with chaos, he could always seek comfort in the hands of his master.

Nook's Crown.name: Nook's Crown
Nook's Crown.flavourText:
Every skull was once a person. 
Though 'Who?' is rarely asked. 
Friends, who wear 
the crown of Nook, 
Never need to ask. 
They remember.

Cameria's Cut.name: Cameria's Cut
Cameria's Cut.flavourText:
"There are two ways to pay, Gold and Blood. I'll take my share in both."

-Cameria the Coldblooded

The Heroic Shot.name: The Heroic Shot
The Heroic Shot.flavourText: Try a thousand times, and eventually you'll have to give up.

The Soul.name: The Soul
The Soul.flavourText: "Most people only have one. I'm a bit of a hoarder."

Pride of the First Ones.name: Pride of the First Ones
Pride of the First Ones.flavourText:
Upon silent paws and masked by the reeds, 
Farrul's hunt begins as the light recedes.

The Bitter Blossom.name: The Bitter Blossom
The Bitter Blossom.flavourText: The pain you feel is of no consequence, it is evolution, to be made whole within something greater.

Last Hope.name: Last Hope
Last Hope.flavourText: As their civilisation crumbled, the Vaal looked to their queen. In her, they saw a way out. In them, she saw a burden she was happy to free herself from.

The Easy Stroll.name: The Easy Stroll
The Easy Stroll.flavourText:
"I'm going for a walk. I'll be back soon."

 - Blonca's last words

The Bear Woman.name: The Bear Woman
The Bear Woman.flavourText:
For the blessed bear in the cave,
A hundred days pass in silence and darkness,
until moon begins its fourth passage,
the bear sheds her beastly fur,
and is reborn, human and whole.

Luck of the Vaal.name: Luck of the Vaal
Luck of the Vaal.flavourText:
They can't be THAT lucky,
or they'd still be here!

The Lord in Black.name: The Lord in Black
The Lord in Black.flavourText:
Thy knee shall bend
in shifting dark,
thy blade shall serve his vigil.
Thy oath shall bind thee
to his mark,
thy flesh shall bear his sigil.

The Mayor.name: The Mayor
The Mayor.flavourText:
A ruler is only as powerful as he is wealthy. 
Control the coin, control the empire.

Lantador's Lost Love.name: Lantador's Lost Love
Lantador's Lost Love.flavourText:
They fought the storm together as one, 
Until the longest of days was done. 
Their love grew stronger
with every breath, 
Until it was broken apart in death.

Lucky Connections.name: Lucky Connections
Lucky Connections.flavourText: Luck is a fool's game, and I know plenty of rich fools.

Broken Promises.name: Broken Promises
Broken Promises.flavourText: Experience teaches us that the cold is not the same as the absence of warmth.

Grave Knowledge.name: Grave Knowledge
Grave Knowledge.flavourText: The dead tell me great insights. They've had nothing but time to sit and think.

The Wedding Gift.name: The Wedding Gift
The Wedding Gift.flavourText: The acolytes congratulated the lucky groom for becoming one with the goddess.

Lucky Bastion.name: Lucky Bastion
Lucky Bastion.flavourText:
Discipline forged our unbreakable Rampart.
Bastion against Despair.

The Cataclysm.name: The Cataclysm
The Cataclysm.flavourText: The mighty warriors traded in blows, the nimble archers in arrows, yet it was the brazen thaumaturgists who would bring catastrophe to all.

The Blessing of Moosh.name: The Blessing of Moosh
The Blessing of Moosh.flavourText: While the Labyrinth traps have claimed countless adventurers, they were not designed with felines in mind.

The Sun.name: The Sun
The Sun.flavourText: Each night, the light dies, and each morning she is born anew, embracing the land in her golden wings.

Squandered Prosperity.name: Squandered Prosperity
Squandered Prosperity.flavourText: "Our rulers are being ridiculous, and we are suffering."

The Eye of the Dragon.name: The Eye of the Dragon
The Eye of the Dragon.flavourText:
Some powers are far too great even for the
gods of old.

Reckless Ambition.name: Reckless Ambition
Reckless Ambition.flavourText: Why settle when more is never enough.

The Escape.name: The Escape
The Escape.flavourText: In fleeing reality, you step into the realm of madness.

The Offspring.name: The Offspring
The Offspring.flavourText: The swarm began with just a couple of children. Now, it is her entire existence.

The Greatest Intentions.name: The Greatest Intentions
The Greatest Intentions.flavourText: Chasing purity in the rising light means facing the darkening edges of the spirit.

The Ethereal.name: The Ethereal
The Ethereal.flavourText:
"Long ago, people looked to the stars, believing they influenced us. Soon, it will be us who influence the stars."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturge

Rebirth.name: Rebirth
Rebirth.flavourText:
He shattered Her smile
Scattered the fragments like ash
All she did was laugh

The Queen.name: The Queen
The Queen.flavourText:
The power of the world, 
lies upon your hands.

Something Dark.name: Something Dark
Something Dark.flavourText: Even in darkness you may find a friend.

The Jeweller's Boon.name: The Jeweller's Boon
The Jeweller's Boon.flavourText: The jeweller's true talent is the capacity to see a jewel's beauty before they draw it out.

The Last Supper.name: The Last Supper
The Last Supper.flavourText: "Bino's brief career as a chef at Axiom saved the executioner a lot of work."

The Ruthless Ceinture.name: The Ruthless Ceinture
The Ruthless Ceinture.flavourText:
In combat, a warrior must first be resourceful,
and second, decisive.

The Sustenance.name: The Sustenance
The Sustenance.flavourText: She took all she had and turned it into something she was craving.

Assassin's Favour.name: Assassin's Favour
Assassin's Favour.flavourText:
By the time their eyes meet, 
the dark deal has long since been made, 
and his fate long since sealed.

Sambodhi's Vow.name: Sambodhi's Vow
Sambodhi's Vow.flavourText:
He dispels dark realms
until mortal sufferings
yield to hopeful light.

The Web.name: The Web
The Web.flavourText:
A weapon, a shelter, a prison.
The web's purpose changes
with the spider's needs.
A lesson we should
take to heart.

The Fox in the Brambles.name: The Fox in the Brambles
The Fox in the Brambles.flavourText: Hemmingsworth 6:10 - "And the fox gazed out from the brambles, unreachable and smirking."

Last Stand.name: Last Stand
Last Stand.flavourText:
Return with your shield...
or on it.

Light and Truth.name: Light and Truth
Light and Truth.flavourText:
Time and change
shall naught avail,
To dim the Light
of Truth's fair grail.

The Journey.name: The Journey
The Journey.flavourText: Oh the places you will go, the sights you will see, the things you will meet.

The Side Quest.name: The Side Quest
The Side Quest.flavourText: You'll never know the things you miss if you keep your eyes closed

Pride Before the Fall.name: Pride Before the Fall
Pride Before the Fall.flavourText:
As Kaom slew the last of his kin,
something deep inside him broke.
And through the cracks, corruption,
pure and black, spread forth.

Underground Forest.name: Underground Forest
Underground Forest.flavourText: "In the forest again... But at least I have these."

Chaotic Disposition.name: Chaotic Disposition
Chaotic Disposition.flavourText: Life isn't what you make of it, it's already been made for you.

Misery in Darkness.name: Misery in Darkness
Misery in Darkness.flavourText:
He wandered the bone-filled depths hoping each corner would be his last.
Eventually, he found Light.

The Enforcer.name: The Enforcer
The Enforcer.flavourText:
"Boss said to get rid of him, didn't say not to make a mess."
- Rune The Goon

Triskaidekaphobia.name: Triskaidekaphobia
Triskaidekaphobia.flavourText: The Mists of Madness prey on those who harbour the deepest of fears.

Immortal Resolve.name: Immortal Resolve
Immortal Resolve.flavourText: The threads of fate are the strongest ties.

Alluring Bounty.name: Alluring Bounty
Alluring Bounty.flavourText:
A treasure worth killing for 
is a treasure worth dying for.

Dying Light.name: Dying Light
Dying Light.flavourText: Even the brightest eventually fade to darkness.

The Lover.name: The Lover
The Lover.flavourText: "I wanted to give you three things. I've given you my eternal love. I've sung to you my most beautiful song. I'd have given you the moon last, but it couldn't be found. I hope you'll accept this instead."

The Standoff.name: The Standoff
The Standoff.flavourText: Sometimes your greatest enemy is the only one keeping you breathing.

The Craving.name: The Craving
The Craving.flavourText: What was once a passing thought tickling the back of the mind is now a desperate, driving desire.

Seven Years Bad Luck.name: Seven Years Bad Luck
Seven Years Bad Luck.flavourText: If enough people believe something to be true, whether or not it is becomes irrelevant.

The Deal.name: The Deal
The Deal.flavourText: In the pursuit of wealth, as in that of power, anything goes.

Echoes of Love.name: Echoes of Love
Echoes of Love.flavourText: "I gave up my body for you. I gave up my name for you. And one day I shall give up my life for you."

I See Brothers.name: I See Brothers
I See Brothers.flavourText:
"Where does the light go
when it is dark?"

Temperance.name: Temperance
Temperance.flavourText:
Good things come
to those who wait;
but, greatness seeks
those who do not come.

The Samurai's Eye.name: The Samurai's Eye
The Samurai's Eye.flavourText: At night, when the seas are calm, and the skies dark, he can see it. The formless fiend that took his eye, and fractured his mind.

Forbidden Power.name: Forbidden Power
Forbidden Power.flavourText: Some things should not be used. Some power is too great a risk.

Doedre's Madness.name: Doedre's Madness
Doedre's Madness.flavourText: "Hold your tongue before I claim it." - Doedre Darktongue

The Doppelganger.name: The Doppelganger
The Doppelganger.flavourText: Upon seeing her face, I am terrified—the moon shows me my own form!

The Saint's Treasure.name: The Saint's Treasure
The Saint's Treasure.flavourText: Publicly, he lived a pious and chaste life of poverty. Privately, tithes and tributes made him and his lascivious company very comfortable indeed.

Atziri's Arsenal.name: Atziri's Arsenal
Atziri's Arsenal.flavourText: In the prison of all sins, will you grasp godhood or sorrow? Only hope lies under the shadows.

The Warden.name: The Warden
The Warden.flavourText: Brutus' first innovation as Lord Incarcerator was a weighted chain around every neck so that his prisoners would forever bow to him.

Mawr Blaidd.name: Mawr Blaidd
Mawr Blaidd.flavourText: Rigwald believed he'd seized great power, but it was the great power that had seized Rigwald

The Catalyst.name: The Catalyst
The Catalyst.flavourText: Simple actions can lead the world to an early grave.

Acclimatisation.name: Acclimatisation
Acclimatisation.flavourText:
The world is ever-changing.
Once-lush woods now lost beneath shifting sands,
Great cities now drown beneath turbulent waters.
Adapt or perish.

The Miracle.name: The Miracle
The Miracle.flavourText:
Despite arriving early,
her silly seraphim
couldn't be happier.
Octavia, 2023

Alivia's Grace.name: Alivia's Grace
Alivia's Grace.flavourText: Her innocence and grace were enough to tame even the wildest of beasts.

Rebirth and Renewal.name: Rebirth and Renewal
Rebirth and Renewal.flavourText: Life has an end, then life begins again.

The Eye of Terror.name: The Eye of Terror
The Eye of Terror.flavourText: The Lord of Chaos dreams as his Eye gazes, unblinking, at his prize. And soon, all shall tremble before his waking form.

The Shepherd's Sandals.name: The Shepherd's Sandals
The Shepherd's Sandals.flavourText: He who watches the flock is himself watched by those with loyalty beyond measure.

Justified Ambition.name: Justified Ambition
Justified Ambition.flavourText:
"Everything I have done has been for Wraeclast. You would pledge your life to me if you saw things my way... and soon, you will."
- High Templar Venarius

The Catch.name: The Catch
The Catch.flavourText: The largest hooks offer the greatest catch, but often the catch is the hook.

The Primordial.name: The Primordial
The Primordial.flavourText:
We play at God with our necromancy, 
but forces far more potent 
sleep within these stones.

The Last Laugh.name: The Last Laugh
The Last Laugh.flavourText:
Holding fast when shadows fall,
Over ruins, jesters call.
Nothing breaks their twisted cheer,
Kings of chaos, friends sincere.

Rats.name: Rats
Rats.flavourText: Whoever said 'more is always better' has obviously never met a rat.

The Apothecary.name: The Apothecary
The Apothecary.flavourText: "You seek the power of my strongest potions, but the price will be far higher than you can imagine."

The Tyrant.name: The Tyrant
The Tyrant.flavourText:
"Fear controls the masses."
- Laszlo, the Scourge

Shard of Fate.name: Shard of Fate
Shard of Fate.flavourText:
Their whims left unknown,
Their life left for others.

The Mercenary.name: The Mercenary
The Mercenary.flavourText: Loyalty can be bought. Just make sure you know who the buyer is.

Perfection.name: Perfection
Perfection.flavourText: There are countless worlds, but only those with limitless potential will be able to achieve perfection.

Destined to Crumble.name: Destined to Crumble
Destined to Crumble.flavourText:
"Let us not forget the most important lesson the Vaal taught us:
Nothing is eternal."
- Siosa Foaga, Imperial Scholar

The Undisputed.name: The Undisputed
The Undisputed.flavourText: To create something truly spectacular, you must risk total failure.

Gemcutter's Promise.name: Gemcutter's Promise
Gemcutter's Promise.flavourText: "I swore to use my position to help the people. What good is power when it just accumulates on the already-powerful?" - Erasmus, Imperial Gemcutter

Three Voices.name: Three Voices
Three Voices.flavourText: The village elders had a curious rule: If you hear three voices scream for aid, flee as fast as you can.

Energy Sword.name: Energy Sword
Energy Sword.flavourText:
To my number one fan.
- Griffin, with love

The Long Con.name: The Long Con
The Long Con.flavourText:
"This was the proudest moment of my life."

"... so far"

Rain of Chaos.name: Rain of Chaos
Rain of Chaos.flavourText:
Fire filled the sky that night 
Chaos reigned 
Where the shards fell 
All was destroyed 
-Jozen Kasigi, retelling an urban legend of the Cataclysm

Ambitious Obsession.name: Ambitious Obsession
Ambitious Obsession.flavourText: The most pathetic person in the world is someone who has sight, but no vision.

The Poet.name: The Poet
The Poet.flavourText:
God had forsaken the land 
And Victario wept.
Corruption consumed the land 
And Victario's tears turned to blood.

The Conduit.name: The Conduit
The Conduit.flavourText: The path to godhood is guided by the hand of sacrifice.

The Pact.name: The Pact
The Pact.flavourText: "On this day I mark the first of many agreements that I will have with this land and its people."

The Journalist.name: The Journalist
The Journalist.flavourText: A good spy doesn't forget she's gone undercover.

The Long Watch.name: The Long Watch
The Long Watch.flavourText: The rain pelts down, Mud grasping at his feet, as thoughts of those in his care bolster his resolve.

Divine Beauty.name: Divine Beauty
Divine Beauty.flavourText:
In a land far away lived 
a maiden most fair.
Her smile melted the coldest
of hearts, her song made
men and beast cry, 
her beauty unparalleled;
Divine.

Luminous Trove.name: Luminous Trove
Luminous Trove.flavourText:
Plenty enter, dreaming of treasure
Twenty bled, slain as they fled
Shadows loom, half left doomed
The blind cries, five lost eyes
Careless twins, a lich's new prize
One as a decoy, none pass the king
Gehennix feeds only on whispers

The Lunaris Priestess.name: The Lunaris Priestess
The Lunaris Priestess.flavourText:
Embrace the Light,
Await the Morrow,
No more Spite,
And no more Sorrow.

Etched in Blood.name: Etched in Blood
Etched in Blood.flavourText: When you strive to write your name on the dense pages of History, someone else, inevitably, must be crossed out.

The Harvester.name: The Harvester
The Harvester.flavourText:
Taste not of their
forbidden fruit.
Theirs is a harvest of
the darkest kind,
twisted, rotten and
damned for eternity.

The Enthusiasts.name: The Enthusiasts
The Enthusiasts.flavourText:
"Glimmers of benevolence,
Shrouded a lacquered lust for power,
Yet still they followed his influence."

Thunderous Skies.name: Thunderous Skies
Thunderous Skies.flavourText: Many that have wielded the power of lightning have said that death by electrocution looks like the victim is more alive than ever before.

The Feast.name: The Feast
The Feast.flavourText: Shame what happened to my husband. He had such good taste.

The Emptiness.name: The Emptiness
The Emptiness.flavourText: He appeared before the Light Eater, and at once knew his soul was damned.

The Price of Devotion.name: The Price of Devotion
The Price of Devotion.flavourText: Unbeknown to Atziri's finest thaumaturgists, their loyalty would require far greater devotion than mere research.

The Gulf.name: The Gulf
The Gulf.flavourText:
I thought love stronger than all,
but time and isolation broke
that which madness could not.

Succor of the Sinless.name: Succor of the Sinless
Succor of the Sinless.flavourText: Blessed is the blood of the beholden disciple. The earth is anointed by his step. The damnable are sanctified by his strike.

The Penitent.name: The Penitent
The Penitent.flavourText: First, I gave my wealth, and we went hungry. Next, I gave my land, and we were homeless. Then, I gave my family, and I was alone. Last, I gave my eyes, and all I could dream was mine.

Earth Drinker.name: Earth Drinker
Earth Drinker.flavourText: Taste and grow strong. Drink too much and be buried.

The Hive of Knowledge.name: The Hive of Knowledge
The Hive of Knowledge.flavourText: Within years of knowledge, distilled by careful craftsmanship, lies great power.

Parasitic Passengers.name: Parasitic Passengers
Parasitic Passengers.flavourText: Feeding on death, they grew stronger and stronger, until they were ready to hatch...

A Chilling Wind.name: A Chilling Wind
A Chilling Wind.flavourText:
All things slow under winter's 
onslaught - even life itself.

The Rabbit's Foot.name: The Rabbit's Foot
The Rabbit's Foot.flavourText: It is said anyone who bears this trinket is the luckiest exile in all of Wraeclast. The gods would disagree, and forever curse any whom give it away.

The Wolven King's Bite.name: The Wolven King's Bite
The Wolven King's Bite.flavourText: A wolf does not bite his mate as he does his prey, yet both begin with bared teeth. Know who you are, and you will know the meaning of the bite.

The Breach.name: The Breach
The Breach.flavourText: Ever get the feeling you're being watched...?

Azyran's Reward.name: Azyran's Reward
Azyran's Reward.flavourText:
Method transcends shape and size. Do something in parallel long enough, and you will always find 
another way.

Boundless Realms.name: Boundless Realms
Boundless Realms.flavourText: Boundless is the distance between where we start and where we start again.

Soul Quenched.name: Soul Quenched
Soul Quenched.flavourText: Weapons such as these require a darker kind of forge...

The Scout.name: The Scout
The Scout.flavourText: The first to travel are often rewarded for their journey, but all the treasure in the world cannot bring back those that are lost.

Society's Remorse.name: Society's Remorse
Society's Remorse.flavourText:
We live to dream of worlds we aren't in,
a false narrative that we use to fill our souls
with doubt;
The world is already beautiful,
there's no need to dream.

Gemcutter's Mercy.name: Gemcutter's Mercy
Gemcutter's Mercy.flavourText:
When you can only have one, which shall it be?
Red?
Blue?
Probably Green.

The Eternal War.name: The Eternal War
The Eternal War.flavourText: They believed, falsely, that the strongest of generals could outlast eons of corruption.

Akil's Prophecy.name: Akil's Prophecy
Akil's Prophecy.flavourText:
The hatungo know many answers to the same question, 
for time itself is a tangled web.

Deathly Designs.name: Deathly Designs
Deathly Designs.flavourText: "The Karui was correct; there is virtue in honouring my ancestors."

A Note in the Wind.name: A Note in the Wind
A Note in the Wind.flavourText:
The artist is long dead,
the lyrics are long forgotten,
yet the Song of War longs to be sung again

The Porcupine.name: The Porcupine
The Porcupine.flavourText: The first quill separates the quick learners from the dead.

Draped in Dreams.name: Draped in Dreams
Draped in Dreams.flavourText:
The suit I wear,
Is heavy and bare.
A canvas, it seems, breathing life into dreams.

The Shortcut.name: The Shortcut
The Shortcut.flavourText: If time is the most valuable currency, how do you make more of it?

The Valley of Steel Boxes.name: The Valley of Steel Boxes
The Valley of Steel Boxes.flavourText:
"The most valuable treasures should be hidden in plain sight." 
- Ina, Keeper of Goods

Toxic Tidings.name: Toxic Tidings
Toxic Tidings.flavourText:
A beast even Einhar
will not hunt.

Dark Dreams.name: Dark Dreams
Dark Dreams.flavourText: No one ever truly understood what she meant when she said she wanted to raise a family.

The Unexpected Prize.name: The Unexpected Prize
The Unexpected Prize.flavourText:
They came from far and wide under a common banner.
They sought companionship and competition,
but found a treasure none had foreseen.

Hunter's Reward.name: Hunter's Reward
Hunter's Reward.flavourText: To tame a beast, you first must subdue its heart.

The Immortal.name: The Immortal
The Immortal.flavourText:
"Greetings! Just because you think I'm greedy doesn't mean I'm not willing to share. You'll just have to kill me first."
-Grandmaster Dy'Ness

Outfoxed.name: Outfoxed
Outfoxed.flavourText:
The prize vanished. 
No trail, no struggle.
Just a single, rust-red hair.

Eternal Bonds.name: Eternal Bonds
Eternal Bonds.flavourText:
Separate, stories untold.
Together, memories unfold.

Cartographer's Delight.name: Cartographer's Delight
Cartographer's Delight.flavourText:
A map is similar
to a pair of eyes,
without one you stumble
around, unable to find your way.

The Last One Standing.name: The Last One Standing
The Last One Standing.flavourText: The strongest emerge from suffering. The toughest bear the most scars. The sole survivor claims the greatest of rewards.

When Currents Blaze.name: When Currents Blaze
When Currents Blaze.flavourText:
In their fiery union,
the storm left the rivers
forever changed.

Dying Anguish.name: Dying Anguish
Dying Anguish.flavourText: Moribund, he gazed upon the journey taken as blood trickled down his chin. His eye closed on the city ahead that he would never call home.

The Price of Loyalty.name: The Price of Loyalty
The Price of Loyalty.flavourText: "Forge me a carapace from their skin, imbued with their soul. Then feed their flesh to the hounds."

The Gemcutter.name: The Gemcutter
The Gemcutter.flavourText: In the hands of a master craftsman, a worthless pebble can adorn the crown of a king.

Divine Justice.name: Divine Justice
Divine Justice.flavourText: Many sought the Goddess' blessing. Few survived the Labyrinth to receive it.

The Fathomless Depths.name: The Fathomless Depths
The Fathomless Depths.flavourText: Fall into endless night; a voyage into an ocean of oblivion.

The Gambler.name: The Gambler
The Gambler.flavourText: "I don't believe in karma. If it were real, I would never win."

Lucky Deck.name: Lucky Deck
Lucky Deck.flavourText: When the outcome is the same, does it matter if it is fortune or trickery?

More is Never Enough.name: More is Never Enough
More is Never Enough.flavourText: Greed is a hunger that only grows as you feed it

The Mountain.name: The Mountain
The Mountain.flavourText:
Charmed by beautiful stones 
Consumed with the 
pursuit of perfection 
Ever deeper into the waiting dark

The Seeker.name: The Seeker
The Seeker.flavourText: All that is flawed is worthless. The slightest error, and this might as well be trash.

Friendship.name: Friendship
Friendship.flavourText:
"Set your life on fire. 
Seek those who
fan your flames"

-Rumi of the Vaal

Matryoshka.name: Matryoshka
Matryoshka.flavourText:
I cannot contain myself,
but I can barely squeak,
so many words I'd have for you,
if I could only speak!

History.name: History
History.flavourText:
The future is oft-foretold
in records of the past.

Endless Night.name: Endless Night
Endless Night.flavourText: The sun shines not for me. I walk in darkness, never free. Time stopped when you both died in my arms.

The World Eater.name: The World Eater
The World Eater.flavourText: Its body knows no limits. Its appetite knows no bounds.

The Risk.name: The Risk
The Risk.flavourText: "There is no right or wrong choice, no best or worst. There are only choices and their consequences."

The Body.name: The Body
The Body.flavourText: They say it is the head that leads, but all must flow through the body at some point.

The Fiend.name: The Fiend
The Fiend.flavourText:
Your era is now,
your power unwavered, 
soon we will see
who the gods truly favoured.

The Celestial Stone.name: The Celestial Stone
The Celestial Stone.flavourText: Stare into its depths too long, and you may lose yourself entirely.

Hunter's Resolve.name: Hunter's Resolve
Hunter's Resolve.flavourText:
Primed, curved and sleek.
Decisive and final.
For malice and righteousness.
There's but one solution.

One Last Score.name: One Last Score
One Last Score.flavourText:
You want to know how
I haven't been caught? 
It's not just speed.
You need some luck.

Darker Half.name: Darker Half
Darker Half.flavourText: When you find what you're looking for, it's never quite right. When you have what you desire, yet you still want more.

The Void.name: The Void
The Void.flavourText: Reach into the Void and claim your prize.

The Cursed King.name: The Cursed King
The Cursed King.flavourText:
The First Ones
may be blasphemy,
but they are
powerful blasphemy.

Glimmer of Hope.name: Glimmer of Hope
Glimmer of Hope.flavourText: When you dwell in total darkness, even the faintest light may guide you out.

The Wind.name: The Wind
The Wind.flavourText: Weaving through the cracks, searching for weaknesses, silent, indiscriminate, leaving sorrow in its wake.

The Obscured.name: The Obscured
The Obscured.flavourText: Our world, dangerous as it is, is far safer than what lies just beyond our sight.

The Sigil.name: The Sigil
The Sigil.flavourText:
Three men travel
through the gate;
they carry a protective ward.
A faction conspires
against their fate,
but magic unravels the sword.

Cursed Words.name: Cursed Words
Cursed Words.flavourText: If you look hard enough for hidden meaning, you will find it.

Judging Voices.name: Judging Voices
Judging Voices.flavourText: He was seeking sanity, but the demons were inside his head.

The Dreamland.name: The Dreamland
The Dreamland.flavourText: All dreams vanish when the dreamers wake.

The Witch.name: The Witch
The Witch.flavourText:
A wanderer in the wild strives 
Against countless foes he survives 
A fool pursues a quest contrived 
By the gift of the witch, alive.

Fateful Meeting.name: Fateful Meeting
Fateful Meeting.flavourText:
Some people act as beacons, illuminating the path for others. I was lucky to meet one such person.

- Anton to Zhenya

Broken Truce.name: Broken Truce
Broken Truce.flavourText: With a single act, years of peace have been shattered. An unknown assassin brings war upon us all.

The Surgeon.name: The Surgeon
The Surgeon.flavourText:
"He might be lacking in vision, but his virtuosity is undeniable."
- Malachai, on Maligaro

The Forgotten Treasure.name: The Forgotten Treasure
The Forgotten Treasure.flavourText: Don't let fool's gold deceive you.

Loyalty.name: Loyalty
Loyalty.flavourText:
Bound by fate,
inseparable by choice.

The Devastator.name: The Devastator
The Devastator.flavourText: Only a fool tries to contain unlimited power.

The Admirer.name: The Admirer
The Admirer.flavourText: Lucian lost himself in ancient scrolls and found in those scrolls a love whose power bridged a millennium.

The Cheater.name: The Cheater
The Cheater.flavourText: Sometimes the best way to achieve greatness is to use a shortcut.

The King's Heart.name: The King's Heart
The King's Heart.flavourText: 500 times Kaom's axe fell, 500 times Kaom's Heart splintered. Finally, all that remained was a terrible, heartless Fury.

Thirst for Knowledge.name: Thirst for Knowledge
Thirst for Knowledge.flavourText:
A ravenous mind can readily take in ideas from any source. 
Fortunately for the scholars, he has already learned about sustainability.

Brush, Paint and Palette.name: Brush, Paint and Palette
Brush, Paint and Palette.flavourText: "Man may shape the world, but these? These shape the man." -Inquisitor Maligaro

The Visionary.name: The Visionary
The Visionary.flavourText: Lioneye looked to the heights of glorious victory. And thus he missed the defeat right under his nose.

The Coming Storm.name: The Coming Storm
The Coming Storm.flavourText: No man may hope to turn back the storm. You can only hope you do not attract its ire.

The Deceiver.name: The Deceiver
The Deceiver.flavourText: Beware the combatant who shows no confidence, yet still enters the ring, for they are surely hiding something.

Lysah's Respite.name: Lysah's Respite
Lysah's Respite.flavourText:
So many memories,
so much pain in
such a small token.
Drown it in blood
so you can forget.

The Academic.name: The Academic
The Academic.flavourText:
"Such dedication for so many years,
all for a couple extra letters at the front of your name..."

The Prince of Darkness.name: The Prince of Darkness
The Prince of Darkness.flavourText: Fear a man who is willing to sacrifice anything for power.

Chasing Risk.name: Chasing Risk
Chasing Risk.flavourText: A fond memory fills me with nostalgia; some men would have felt guilt, but I felt no regret over the anguish and fear my ambitions caused.

Poisoned Faith.name: Poisoned Faith
Poisoned Faith.flavourText: Even our most devout beliefs are subtly shaped by our darkest desires.

The Cartographer.name: The Cartographer
The Cartographer.flavourText:
My son, you lost your way before you arrived.
To never lose you again,
I make a path in my heart.

The Sacrifice.name: The Sacrifice
The Sacrifice.flavourText: For some, the price of power is never too great.

The Valkyrie.name: The Valkyrie
The Valkyrie.flavourText:
The villain strikes,
the world is torn.
A war begins, a hero is born,
The nemesis sets the sky alight.
A hero's sacrifice
sets everything right.
- Drake's Epitaph

The Tumbleweed.name: The Tumbleweed
The Tumbleweed.flavourText: Love is the only redemption after succumbing to the grasps of the Wasteland.

Bijoux.name: Bijoux
Bijoux.flavourText: "Such fine trinkets show their true value in times of crisis." - Tangmazu

Magnum Opus.name: Magnum Opus
Magnum Opus.flavourText: Wraeclast will unite. This shall be my great work - the minds of the people made one.

Reflection of the Heart.name: Reflection of the Heart
Reflection of the Heart.flavourText:
He thought she was all
he ever wanted,
yet his heart yearned
for something more.

The Lich.name: The Lich
The Lich.flavourText: When the dead raise and master their own, the land is truly lost.

The Endurance.name: The Endurance
The Endurance.flavourText:
Crimson rubies, drops of vigour,
flowing through my veins,
flesh like coal, try to crush me,
diamond is what remains.

The Rabid Rhoa.name: The Rabid Rhoa
The Rabid Rhoa.flavourText:
"Experiment 22A: Rhoas, when deprived of water, secrete a most delightfully potent toxin."
- Maligaro

The Rusted Bard.name: The Rusted Bard
The Rusted Bard.flavourText:
Fourfold the refrain, fortissimo cheer.
One hundred rent twain, naught left for a bier.
The song rattles on, though hollow a bit.
See the hope is gone, no prize shall ye get.

Runic Luck.name: Runic Luck
Runic Luck.flavourText:
If you believe hard enough,
you'll win.

The Siren.name: The Siren
The Siren.flavourText:
At the beck and call
of The Siren's hand,
winter ravages
the trembling land,
and the weight of ice that binds
will break the strongest of minds.

Avian Pursuit.name: Avian Pursuit
Avian Pursuit.flavourText:
Blazing through the night
Longing for infinite flight
Awaiting dawn's first light

The Price of Prescience.name: The Price of Prescience
The Price of Prescience.flavourText: The strange voice showed Aul a future where his legacy was forgotten, where new cultures broke themselves upon Aul's ruined world.

The Hale Heart.name: The Hale Heart
The Hale Heart.flavourText: Though the years weakened his mind, his body remained deadly as ever.

The Astromancer.name: The Astromancer
The Astromancer.flavourText:
They would say that he was a dangerous man,
unbound by the sense of morality,
but what does this matter,
when his love for humanity is undeniable
and completion of his work would benefit everyone?

The Shieldbearer.name: The Shieldbearer
The Shieldbearer.flavourText: While you grow, I shall be your knight, and you my squire. One day, you shall be the one who stands and defends our home.

The Scarred Meadow.name: The Scarred Meadow
The Scarred Meadow.flavourText: The earth offers nourishment, growth and healing. Unless, of course, the sky has other plans.

The Twins.name: The Twins

The Aspirant.name: The Aspirant
The Aspirant.flavourText:
Those Exiles that survive Wraeclast
dream not of home, but of power.

Audacity.name: Audacity
Audacity.flavourText:
A jolt, and it moves. Or smolders.
A current, and it lives. Or dies.
A surge, and it transcends.
Or... not.
Only one way to find out.

The Demon.name: The Demon
The Demon.flavourText: A man who hears voices may not necessarily be crazy.

Three Faces in the Dark.name: Three Faces in the Dark
Three Faces in the Dark.flavourText: For every threat you spy in the shadows, there are two others you don't.

Prosperity.name: Prosperity
Prosperity.flavourText: Accumulating wealth has its own costs.

Brother's Stash.name: Brother's Stash
Brother's Stash.flavourText:
Even though he found the stash just in time,
He would trade it all away and then some to have him back.

Assassin's Gift.name: Assassin's Gift
Assassin's Gift.flavourText:
What matters are
the Marks of your life,
not its Longevity.

Time-Lost Relic.name: Time-Lost Relic
Time-Lost Relic.flavourText: Time cannot wash away that which cannot be forgotten.

Lethean Temptation.name: Lethean Temptation
Lethean Temptation.flavourText: My memories tortured me without end. To escape them, I embraced nothingness, but oblivion simply brought a different kind of pain...

Damnation.name: Damnation
Damnation.flavourText:
Blood and death lead
the way to hell.

The Demoness.name: The Demoness
The Demoness.flavourText: Wherever she went, death was sure to follow.

Terrible Secret of Space.name: Terrible Secret of Space
Terrible Secret of Space.flavourText: They said they were here to protect us.

Haunting Shadows.name: Haunting Shadows
Haunting Shadows.flavourText:
In the dead of night you may elude your shadows,
but they will always find you by dawn.

Baited Expectations.name: Baited Expectations
Baited Expectations.flavourText: The line between having not enough to do and too much to do is unusually fine.

The Professor.name: The Professor
The Professor.flavourText: The academic route to knowledge is wide and well-trodden; but it is the untaught one who scales the mountain.

The Doctor.name: The Doctor
The Doctor.flavourText: "They said I needed my head examined, but I'd rather just take yours." - Klopek the Cannibal

The Master Artisan.name: The Master Artisan
The Master Artisan.flavourText: Perfection is the standard, excellence will be handled on a case by case basis.

Divine Shard.name: Divine Shard
Divine Shard.flavourText:
Sin sought to contain Divinity
so that no mortal would gain
such monstrous power ever again.

Dark Temptation.name: Dark Temptation
Dark Temptation.flavourText:
"Only a fool looks to the occult for power and expects to be spared from its wrath." 
- Voll, Emperor of Purity

Burning Blood.name: Burning Blood
Burning Blood.flavourText:
There's a place where up is down, 
where right is wrong, 
where pleasure is agony, 
and where the living wish only for death.

The Eldritch Decay.name: The Eldritch Decay
The Eldritch Decay.flavourText: Time dismantles all things eventually, but some wish to accelerate the process.

Her Mask.name: Her Mask
Her Mask.flavourText:
To her beauty you submit,
lest your neck the great Queen slit.

Vile Power.name: Vile Power
Vile Power.flavourText:
Dread and danger 
makes the air feel thin. 
Above, power slumbers, tempting fate. 
Greed and ambition 
draws countless in, 
For those who seek power 
can never wait.

Anarchy's Price.name: Anarchy's Price
Anarchy's Price.flavourText: Born of relentless fury and abhorrence, warped by turmoil and anguish, tainted through desire and carnality, I thirst for bloodshed once more.

The Dragon's Heart.name: The Dragon's Heart
The Dragon's Heart.flavourText: They say when a dragon dies, the flesh smoulders and burns until all that remains is the still, white-hot, heart.

The Fool.name: The Fool
The Fool.flavourText: Even the most learned man is a fool to his own fate.

Left to Fate.name: Left to Fate
Left to Fate.flavourText:
Many strive for greatness,
but it is challenge, unforeseen,
that forges heroes.

Apocalypse.name: Apocalypse
Apocalypse.flavourText:
The Ezomytes,
buried beneath flaming mountains
by the First Ones.
The Vaal,
undone by a cataclysm
of their own making.
Are all empires fated to fall to hubris?

Council of Cats.name: Council of Cats
Council of Cats.flavourText:
A King Loved By All,
A Shadow Awaiting Nightfall,
A Speaker Howling Away,
A Hunter Seeking Prey

The Incantation.name: The Incantation
The Incantation.flavourText: When there is no other choice, even the meekest whisper can bring about the greatest storm.

The Inventor.name: The Inventor
The Inventor.flavourText:
Jump right in, 
But beware 
Of things broken 
Or beyond compare.

The Wolf's Shadow.name: The Wolf's Shadow
The Wolf's Shadow.flavourText: "If I fall, we will fall together with my fangs in your throat."

The Lake.name: The Lake
The Lake.flavourText:
Gaze upon the Lake
Gaze upon your Reflection
Your full Potential

Call to the First Ones.name: Call to the First Ones
Call to the First Ones.flavourText: The Ezomyte, desperate for aid, cried out to the gods.

The Awakened.name: The Awakened
The Awakened.flavourText: Some seek to change the world. Others change the world as a consequence of what they seek.

The Damned.name: The Damned
The Damned.flavourText:
Souls along a conduit of blood, 
from one vessel to the next.

The Jester.name: The Jester
The Jester.flavourText:
Summoned for the King's desire,
soon applause came from the court.
However insanity was his only sire,
so the King's reign was cut short.

Abandoned Wealth.name: Abandoned Wealth
Abandoned Wealth.flavourText: When the world burned, the greedy burned with it, while the clever left as paupers.

Boon of Justice.name: Boon of Justice
Boon of Justice.flavourText: Some gifts are obligations while others are simply opportunities.

The Magma Crab.name: The Magma Crab
The Magma Crab.flavourText: Drink deeply of living rock and be as stone, with blood afire.

Lingering Remnants.name: Lingering Remnants
Lingering Remnants.flavourText:
Never dying, yet not living,
Endlessly they wander
beneath the harvest moon.

Astral Protection.name: Astral Protection
Astral Protection.flavourText:
For a time, we had something stronger than eldritch evil.
We had each other.

Checkmate.name: Checkmate
Checkmate.flavourText: When victory is impossible, each of us plays only to delay the end.

Doryani's Epiphany.name: Doryani's Epiphany
Doryani's Epiphany.flavourText: "Virtue gems have facets beyond those that can be seen by the mortal eye. Let us look deeper..."

The Explorer.name: The Explorer
The Explorer.flavourText: A map is only useful if you know where you stand.

House of Mirrors.name: House of Mirrors
House of Mirrors.flavourText: What do you see in the mirror?

Jack in the Box.name: Jack in the Box
Jack in the Box.flavourText:
Turn the crank, 
close your eyes, 
and pray to the gods 
for a pleasant surprise.

The Return of the Rat.name: The Return of the Rat
The Return of the Rat.flavourText: And he shall be heralded by the screams of the damned.

Prometheus' Armoury.name: Prometheus' Armoury
Prometheus' Armoury.flavourText: It is a mortal man's folly to seek power beyond his comprehension.

The Wolf's Legacy.name: The Wolf's Legacy
The Wolf's Legacy.flavourText: The howls and cackling could not mask the sadness.

The Fox.name: The Fox
The Fox.flavourText:
"Masters of wit, strength and cunning. To survive the harsh winters, you must be like the fox."
- Ezomyte Proverb

The Hermit.name: The Hermit
The Hermit.flavourText: The hermit's only friend is the greenery he can find.

Turn the Other Cheek.name: Turn the Other Cheek
Turn the Other Cheek.flavourText:
"Only after one forsakes rage, can true power be found."
- Sekhema Asenath

The Mad King.name: The Mad King
The Mad King.flavourText: Fear the man who lusts for power, for he will do anything to get it.

Coveted Possession.name: Coveted Possession
Coveted Possession.flavourText: A taste of power brings a hunger for more.

The Lion.name: The Lion
The Lion.flavourText: The Eternals lauded his valour. The Karui relished his defeat. Yet the final thoughts of Marceus Lioneye were naught but lament for his pride.

Gift of the Gemling Queen.name: Gift of the Gemling Queen
Gift of the Gemling Queen.flavourText:
Our Lady Dialla,
as a symbol of our progress,
shines greater than all the gems.

The Progeny of Lunaris.name: The Progeny of Lunaris
The Progeny of Lunaris.flavourText:
Born beneath silver light, bearing Lunaris' mark.
Conjuring all his might, the Prodigy turned light to dark.

The Union.name: The Union
The Union.flavourText:
On the 21st of Eterni, 
two become one, 
their light outshines 
the setting sun.

The Inoculated.name: The Inoculated
The Inoculated.flavourText: Chaos spread, wreaking havoc and death. They said none would be spared, and yet here I stand.

The Beast.name: The Beast
The Beast.flavourText: To know the monster, you must become the monster.

Merciless Armament.name: Merciless Armament
Merciless Armament.flavourText:
"Through thick and thin,
blood and bone,
a peaceful life
is one I can't condone."
- Tukohama, Father Of War

The Innocent.name: The Innocent
The Innocent.flavourText: His brother would not atone, so he took his brother's life, and with it, his sins.

The Bargain.name: The Bargain
The Bargain.flavourText: In the pursuit of power, as in that of wealth, anything goes.

The Price of Protection.name: The Price of Protection
The Price of Protection.flavourText:
To protect her mansion, she would cut a deal with anyone. Anything. 

Something answered.

The Scholar.name: The Scholar
The Scholar.flavourText: It is with the smallest of words that we find the largest of truths.

A Dab of Ink.name: A Dab of Ink
A Dab of Ink.flavourText: The Poet's blood is the Empire's ink.

The Twilight Moon.name: The Twilight Moon
The Twilight Moon.flavourText: The day is dying, the night is born, the air grows cool, the sky is torn.

Lachrymal Necrosis.name: Lachrymal Necrosis
Lachrymal Necrosis.flavourText: Without the ability to weep, the heart hardens against both the pure and the corrupt.

The Slumbering Beast.name: The Slumbering Beast
The Slumbering Beast.flavourText:
He slumbers...
But soon he will awaken.

The Celestial Justicar.name: The Celestial Justicar
The Celestial Justicar.flavourText: Wrapped in the glory of the heavens, she comes to mete out justice for the fallen.

The Landing.name: The Landing
The Landing.flavourText: Warriors of a distant land, you embark on a journey from which you may not return, but which we will be all the better for.

The Drunken Aristocrat.name: The Drunken Aristocrat
The Drunken Aristocrat.flavourText: The finer the brew, the harder it is to remember drinking it.

Blessing of God.name: Blessing of God
Blessing of God.flavourText: When the darkness weighs upon you, grow light from within.

Heterochromia.name: Heterochromia
Heterochromia.flavourText:
Black and White, Silver and Gold
Let us see the world Unfold
Red and Blue, Yellow and Green
Let us remake it in colours Unseen

The Transformation.name: The Transformation
The Transformation.flavourText: Even the most beautiful of transformations can still have a dark side.

Guardian's Challenge.name: Guardian's Challenge
Guardian's Challenge.flavourText: To accept a challenge from the void is merely suicide for the unprepared.

The King's Blade.name: The King's Blade
The King's Blade.flavourText:
"To know for what you fight. To get up again when you've been struck down. To outmanoeuvre someone faster, trick someone smarter, crush someone stronger. That's what it takes to claim the crown."
- Daresso, the King of Swords

The Fishmonger.name: The Fishmonger
The Fishmonger.flavourText: However vicious Rhoas might be, a dedicated angler may in time tame them.

Unrequited Love.name: Unrequited Love
Unrequited Love.flavourText:
The pale flame of his heart disappeared in his azure reflection.
The work of a life.
Ambitious, and unfinished.

Auspicious Ambitions.name: Auspicious Ambitions
Auspicious Ambitions.flavourText:
"Gaze upon the mirrors of what may come and step backward into infinity." 
- Dexion, Thaumetic Aspirant

The Insane Cat.name: The Insane Cat
The Insane Cat.flavourText: One person's madness is another person's reality.

Lonely Warrior.name: Lonely Warrior
Lonely Warrior.flavourText:
A true warrior fights
for those who cannot
fight for themselves.

The Forsaken.name: The Forsaken
The Forsaken.flavourText: You gave us life and love, more than you could spare. Now you're gone, and we are stranded, alone, cold and without purpose.

Remembrance.name: Remembrance
Remembrance.flavourText:
"For all your struggles, all your achievements, even for the greatest of us, a story is all that remains. Write it well." 

-Julius Perandus, Father of Chitus

Sambodhi's Wisdom.name: Sambodhi's Wisdom
Sambodhi's Wisdom.flavourText:
No blade conquers sin;
guide a sinner to virtue,
unveil their lost sight—
your eyes, too, see in
everyone the inner child,
no matter their might.

The Chains that Bind.name: The Chains that Bind
The Chains that Bind.flavourText: Scarier than any criminal is an innocent man in chains, for when he breaks free, his revenge will be justified.

A Modest Request.name: A Modest Request
A Modest Request.flavourText:
Cede all power and wealth to me and serve me in perpetuity.
A minor inconvenience I assure you.

The Thaumaturgist.name: The Thaumaturgist
The Thaumaturgist.flavourText:
"Mastery of thaumaturgy is like any other pursuit; it requires dedication and sacrifice. Sometimes several sacrifices."
- Shavronne of Umbra

The Wolverine.name: The Wolverine
The Wolverine.flavourText: Claw them from the bottom, you'll be glad that you have got 'em, claw them from the top, you'll never want to stop.

A Sea of Blue.name: A Sea of Blue
A Sea of Blue.flavourText: The harvest ended, the floods began.

The One With All.name: The One With All
The One With All.flavourText:
Embrace death to honour the lost,
no fear in life no matter the cost. 
With one of all we are, 
and all of one we trust, 
throughout past, present and future... be just.

The Fletcher.name: The Fletcher
The Fletcher.flavourText: Let these fine arrows pack a punch.

The Nurse.name: The Nurse
The Nurse.flavourText: We tried to tell him to get his head checked.

Desperate Crusade.name: Desperate Crusade
Desperate Crusade.flavourText: Through despondent hardships, those strong of spirit shall claim the prize.

Demigod's Wager.name: Demigod's Wager
Demigod's Wager.flavourText: Sometimes you need to make your own luck.

The Forward Gaze.name: The Forward Gaze
The Forward Gaze.flavourText: "When they realize our true intent, they will decry us, assault us, and try to crush what we have built. We must stand tall, Qotra, and make the future our own."

Man With Bear.name: Man With Bear
Man With Bear.flavourText: A stereotypical joke may lead to an unexpected bond.

The Betrayal.name: The Betrayal
The Betrayal.flavourText: It's sad times we live in when a friendship has a price people are willing to pay.

The Trial.name: The Trial
The Trial.flavourText: You cannot journey to new lands until you have the courage to leave the safety of home.

The Arena Champion.name: The Arena Champion
The Arena Champion.flavourText: The fight is the easy part. It's the years of training that'll kill you.

Unchained.name: Unchained
Unchained.flavourText: Mold the world with your bare hands. Be careful, for what is your doing might become your undoing.

The Pack Leader.name: The Pack Leader
The Pack Leader.flavourText: Become the leader you were born to be.

From Bone to Ashes.name: From Bone to Ashes
From Bone to Ashes.flavourText: For centuries, they stood vigil in secret over their sleeping goddess, even as contamination oozed out of the decadent Vaal empire.

The Forbidden Fruit.name: The Forbidden Fruit
The Forbidden Fruit.flavourText:
It's about working smarter,
not harder.

Death.name: Death
Death.flavourText:
The end of the old,
the beginning of the new.
A unique opportunity for transformation,
for those with the power
to grasp it.

The Darkest Dream.name: The Darkest Dream
The Darkest Dream.flavourText: A dream from which you cannot awake is nothing other than a nightmare.

The Leviathan.name: The Leviathan
The Leviathan.flavourText:
Ancient behemoths swam the
depths of the oceans long
before Man walked these lands.

The Offering.name: The Offering
The Offering.flavourText: Eternal beauty has a cost, one which Shavronne was happy to pay with the lives of others.

The Stormcaller.name: The Stormcaller
The Stormcaller.flavourText:
If you beckon the
Lord of Lightning,
do not be surprised
when you are struck.

A Fate Worse Than Death.name: A Fate Worse Than Death
A Fate Worse Than Death.flavourText: "It was as though my very thoughts were breaking... fracturing into tiny motes to be lost on the wind."

The Enlightened.name: The Enlightened
The Enlightened.flavourText:
Weaving the six,
a serpent stands tall.
Wearing a crown,
the thousand petals call.

The Sephirot.name: The Sephirot
The Sephirot.flavourText: If the path to divinity were simple, we'd all be gods.

The Road to Power.name: The Road to Power
The Road to Power.flavourText: A beacon on the horizon; a guiding light, a call for help, or a warning to turn back.

Beauty Through Death.name: Beauty Through Death
Beauty Through Death.flavourText:
Her beauty did not fade 
her humanity did not survive.

Love Through Ice.name: Love Through Ice
Love Through Ice.flavourText:
"I know one lady for whose sake I will rip out my heart"

- Derrok, the Dreamer

Fire Of Unknown Origin.name: Fire Of Unknown Origin

The Warlord.name: The Warlord
The Warlord.flavourText:
To cure the Goddess,
and break the chains of corruption,
you must shatter the world.

Wealth and Power.name: Wealth and Power
Wealth and Power.flavourText: The greatness of a man is not in how much wealth or power he acquires, but in his integrity and his ability to positively affect those around him.

Imperfect Memories.name: Imperfect Memories
Imperfect Memories.flavourText: Everything is eroded by time, but sometimes the edges that fade can make a wonderful memory even more beautiful.

The Cache.name: The Cache
The Cache.flavourText:
Vintage or crafted, Glittering and shiny
Dusty or glittering, huge or tiny
Secured within a chest 
or unearthed from your mining
Find jewellery everywhere, 
no need for divining!
So why is it so hard 
to figure out which one to wear?
This one makes me stronger, 
but does it match my hair?

The Aesthete.name: The Aesthete
The Aesthete.flavourText:
"Some see our mortal flesh as a limitation. I see it as an opportunity for vast, miraculous improvements."
- Shavronne of Umbra

The Brittle Emperor.name: The Brittle Emperor
The Brittle Emperor.flavourText:
"When Voll spared Malachai, accepting his aid in pursuit of Purity, the strongest faith was infected by Corruption and made brittle as glass."
- Victario, the People's Poet

The Artist.name: The Artist
The Artist.flavourText: "Paint, metal, flesh... A true artist does not limit himself." - Malachai the Soulless

The Dapper Prodigy.name: The Dapper Prodigy
The Dapper Prodigy.flavourText: "Many believe murder is a grisly, grim, and grotesque crime. Then there are those who simply make art of it."

The Formless Sea.name: The Formless Sea
The Formless Sea.flavourText:
Formless might,
Wild beauty tamed,
The brine of gods,
The seas restrained.

The Life Thief.name: The Life Thief
The Life Thief.flavourText:
"The process of eternal youth is a give and take. You give them death and take their youth."
- Zerphi of the Vaal

A Mother's Parting Gift.name: A Mother's Parting Gift
A Mother's Parting Gift.flavourText:
Nature was her domain,
Love was her song,
Family was her devotion,
Knowledge was her gift.

The Patient.name: The Patient
The Patient.flavourText: I have a headache, can anyone find me a nurse?

The Everlasting.name: The Everlasting
The Everlasting.flavourText:
The Atlas invites us all
to a lifelong journey.
It would be unwise
to overstay our welcome.

A Familiar Call.name: A Familiar Call
A Familiar Call.flavourText:
The mighty huntress always called for her share,
But what we shared was a lifelong bond.

The Battle Born.name: The Battle Born
The Battle Born.flavourText: "No man can best me, no demon can fell me. For I vanquish all with my axe!"

The Dungeon Master.name: The Dungeon Master
The Dungeon Master.flavourText: "So desperate was I for control, I turned my entire world into a prison. Now you will share in my agony."

The Blazing Fire.name: The Blazing Fire
The Blazing Fire.flavourText: Lethal, untouchable, keen, aflame. Just what I was looking for.

Dialla's Subjugation.name: Dialla's Subjugation
Dialla's Subjugation.flavourText:
A symbol of beauty and innocence
The gems corrupted her mind
Malachai corrupted her gems
All but a glimmer of
greatness lost in madness

The Whiteout.name: The Whiteout
The Whiteout.flavourText:
They thought winter had come early,
that snow blanketed the land,
but in truth, all their chickens
had come home to roost.

Altered Perception.name: Altered Perception
Altered Perception.flavourText: You mustn't forget: you won't be leaving this place.

The Realm.name: The Realm
The Realm.flavourText: If you wish to rush into strange places, be prepared to face strange things.

The Puzzle.name: The Puzzle
The Puzzle.flavourText: As countless fractures weaken the divide, nightmares seep through from the other side.

Tranquillity.name: Tranquillity
Tranquillity.flavourText: Beware the sudden calm, for it is a sure sign of a storm on the horizon.

The Rite of Elements.name: The Rite of Elements
The Rite of Elements.flavourText:
A mind as quick as lightning, 
fists as hard as stone, 
a heart that burns with fury, 
and eyes that chill to the bone.

The Skeleton.name: The Skeleton
The Skeleton.flavourText: They stand among us, and within us.

Ever-Changing.name: Ever-Changing
Ever-Changing.flavourText: The Atlas is our prison, and our only defence. She is our only hope, and our certain doom.

The Spoiled Prince.name: The Spoiled Prince
The Spoiled Prince.flavourText: A boy who grows up with everything learns to appreciate nothing.

The Wolf.name: The Wolf
The Wolf.flavourText: The largest beasts cannot be overpowered. The Greatwolf teaches us to use guile, not strength, to probe for the soft flesh and strike deep.

Volatile Power.name: Volatile Power
Volatile Power.flavourText: Unlimited power is apt to corrupt the minds of those who possess it.

The Gladiator.name: The Gladiator
The Gladiator.flavourText:
The thumb turns down
and the crowd roars, 
they want death 
and the blood is yours.

The Calling.name: The Calling
The Calling.flavourText: Blood flows not just through veins, but through worlds.

The Insatiable.name: The Insatiable
The Insatiable.flavourText: A lust for souls. The urge to kill just to satisfy its thirst. An unbearable burden that would make even the purest heart blacken over time.

The Old Man.name: The Old Man
The Old Man.flavourText: Hear me, fish! I love and respect you, but before this day ends I will kill you dead.

The Opulent.name: The Opulent
The Opulent.flavourText: Wealth can, in fact, buy happiness.

Costly Curio.name: Costly Curio
Costly Curio.flavourText: "Oh no, I couldn't possibly afford this fine artefact. I'm... just looking."

Alone in the Darkness.name: Alone in the Darkness
Alone in the Darkness.flavourText:
"Sometimes, the most beautiful treasures...are the ones you cannot have." 
- Beryl, Survivor from the Azurite Mines

Winter's Embrace.name: Winter's Embrace
Winter's Embrace.flavourText:
Come home to me, my sweet.
Oh, how long you've been!
Lie with me in the frozen dark.
I may yet find forgiveness
Now that fear has left you.

The Undaunted.name: The Undaunted
The Undaunted.flavourText:
"Fate was always my nemesis... 
But it didn't stop me then, and it won't stop me now."
- Kjetilbrann, The Undaunted

Pearls Before Swine.name: Pearls Before Swine
Pearls Before Swine.flavourText:
The unknowledgable know not
what treasures lie so closely
within their feeble reach.

Duality.name: Duality
Duality.flavourText: Good and Evil can be woven together to become something greater than either.

Bound by Flame.name: Bound by Flame
Bound by Flame.flavourText:
In battle we burn together
or not at all.

Void of the Elements.name: Void of the Elements
Void of the Elements.flavourText: Though the forces of nature are mighty and intimidating, it is their absence which should be feared.

The Archmage's Right Hand.name: The Archmage's Right Hand
The Archmage's Right Hand.flavourText: "When grasped in his hand, even an ordinary piece of wood can make the heavens tremble with fear."

The Hoarder.name: The Hoarder
The Hoarder.flavourText: "More! I want more!" - Faendris, the Insatiable

Disdain.name: Disdain
Disdain.flavourText: No man sees all, but you'll see more than some see in a lifetime.

The Golden Era.name: The Golden Era
The Golden Era.flavourText: Before gemlings, before thaumaturgy, a simple court magician could enthrall the masses.

The Metalsmith's Gift.name: The Metalsmith's Gift
The Metalsmith's Gift.flavourText: A month's work, a year's wages, a foolish shortcut through a Rhoa's nest, and a grieving bride-to-be, who never received her betrothed's great gift.

The Hook.name: The Hook
The Hook.flavourText: Every obsession began with a single, innocent taste.

Arrogance of the Vaal.name: Arrogance of the Vaal
Arrogance of the Vaal.flavourText: Discovery can lead to beauty, or it can lead to ruin.

The Strategist.name: The Strategist
The Strategist.flavourText: Know thine enemy better than you know thyself.

The Brawny Battle Mage.name: The Brawny Battle Mage
The Brawny Battle Mage.flavourText: A humble piece of wood offers the simplest solution to life's problems: just hit them really, really hard.

Scholar of the Seas.name: Scholar of the Seas
Scholar of the Seas.flavourText: I've never come upon a ship I could not command. I have however met sailors that were not willing to be led.

The Endless Darkness.name: The Endless Darkness
The Endless Darkness.flavourText: Gaze towards the stars, but beware what gazes back.

Treasures of the Vaal.name: Treasures of the Vaal
Treasures of the Vaal.flavourText:
The cities of the Empire were plundered
by those who came after... all but one.

Choking Guilt.name: Choking Guilt
Choking Guilt.flavourText: As death approached, clarity eluded him. The pain he had wrought surrounded him, dragging him into darkness.

Harmony of Souls.name: Harmony of Souls
Harmony of Souls.flavourText:
Shrieking souls locked away 
Hate splits frozen cells asunder 
The knot of corruption
undone at last

The Wilted Rose.name: The Wilted Rose
The Wilted Rose.flavourText: Though the path to divinity is fraught with peril, hope may bloom from within.

The Summoner.name: The Summoner
The Summoner.flavourText: To own a piece of the Nightmare, you must first belong to the Nightmare.

The Wretched.name: The Wretched
The Wretched.flavourText: Necromancers, believe me, are more terrifying than their thralls.

Eldritch Perfection.name: Eldritch Perfection
Eldritch Perfection.flavourText:
Embrace horror.
Bathe in its beauty.

Gift of Asenath.name: Gift of Asenath
Gift of Asenath.flavourText: The Golden Sekhema's words could solve many a feud. Just what form that solution took was another matter.
